command:
new foundry.applications.api.DialogV2({ window: { title: "Relieve Stress" }, classes: ["macro-popup-dialog"], position: { width: 600 }, content: `

Relieve Stress

Occasionally, certain moments, places, or events can automatically relieve your stress. Escaping perilous situations, finding a serene location, or experiencing a touching moment with a loved one can have meaningful impacts on your mood and outlook on life. If your stress is getting close to 20, you should consider making a Rest Save - as the effects of a failed Panic Check can be devastating.
Select your modification:
`, buttons: [ { label: `Relieve 1 Stress`, action: 'one', icon: `fas fa-angle-down`, callback: () => game.mothershiprpg.modify('system.other.stress.value', { kind: 'amount', amount: -1 }) }, { label: `Relieve 2 Stress`, action: 'two', icon: `fas fa-angle-double-down`, callback: () => game.mothershiprpg.modify('system.other.stress.value', { kind: 'amount', amount: -2 }) }, { label: `Relieve 1d5 Stress`, action: 'roll', icon: `fas fa-arrow-circle-down`, callback: () => game.mothershiprpg.modify('system.other.stress.value', { kind: 'roll', dice: '-1d5' }) } ] }).render({ force: true });
name: Relieve Stress
